DL3000.title: Use absolute WORKDIR
DL3000.recommendation: Always use an absolute path for WORKDIR instead of a relative path.
DL3000.impact: Relative paths may resolve unexpectedly, causing builds to behave differently.

DL3001.title: For some bash commands the pipefail option is required
DL3001.recommendation: Use 'set -o pipefail' before executing commands connected with pipes.
DL3001.impact: Pipeline failures may be hidden, allowing Docker images to build successfully despite errors.

DL3002.title: Last USER should not be root
DL3002.recommendation: Switch to a non-root user before the final image is built.
DL3002.impact: Running containers as root increases the impact of a container compromise.

DL3003.title: Use WORKDIR instead of cd
DL3003.recommendation: Replace shell 'cd' commands with the WORKDIR instruction.
DL3003.impact: Using WORKDIR improves readability and avoids directory state issues between Dockerfile layers.

DL3004.title: Do not use sudo
DL3004.recommendation: Remove sudo from Dockerfile commands because Docker build steps already run with sufficient privileges.
DL3004.impact: Using sudo adds unnecessary complexity and may not work in minimal base images.

DL3005.title: Avoid apt-get upgrade
DL3005.recommendation: Install only required packages instead of performing a full system upgrade.
DL3005.impact: Upgrading all packages reduces reproducibility and may introduce unexpected changes.

DL3006.title: Always tag the image explicitly
DL3006.recommendation: Specify an explicit image tag instead of relying on the latest tag.
DL3006.impact: Using implicit tags makes builds non-reproducible.

DL3007.title: Using latest is prone to errors
DL3007.recommendation: Replace the 'latest' tag with a fixed version.
DL3007.impact: Images using latest may change unexpectedly between builds.

DL3008.title: Pin versions in apt-get install
DL3008.recommendation: Specify package versions when installing packages using apt-get.
DL3008.impact: Version pinning improves reproducibility and supply-chain security.

DL3009.title: Delete apt lists after install
DL3009.impact: Cleaning package lists reduces image size.

DL3010.title: Use ADD only for archive extraction
DL3010.recommendation: Prefer COPY unless automatic archive extraction is required.
DL3010.impact: COPY has more predictable behavior than ADD.

DL3011.title: Valid UNIX ports
DL3011.impact: Invalid ports may cause deployment failures.

DL3012.title: Multiple HEALTHCHECK instructions
DL3012.recommendation: Use only one HEALTHCHECK instruction in a Dockerfile.
DL3012.impact: Only the last HEALTHCHECK is effective.

DL3013.title: Pin pip versions
DL3013.recommendation: Specify exact package versions in pip install commands.
DL3013.impact: Version pinning prevents unexpected dependency changes.

DL3014.title: Use -y with zypper
DL3014.recommendation: Use the non-interactive '-y' option for zypper.
DL3014.impact: Interactive commands can cause automated builds to hang.

DL3015.title: Avoid additional packages with apk
DL3015.impact: Avoids unnecessary package cache files and reduces image size.

DL3016.title: Pin npm package versions
DL3016.recommendation: Specify exact versions when installing npm packages globally.

DL3017.title: Avoid apk cache
DL3017.impact: Prevents unnecessary cache files from being stored in the image.

DL3018.title: Pin apk package versions
DL3018.recommendation: Specify exact versions when installing Alpine packages.

DL3019.title: Use --no-cache with apk
DL3019.recommendation: Always include --no-cache when using apk add.
DL3019.impact: Reduces image size and avoids stale package indexes.

DL3020.title: Use COPY instead of ADD for files
DL3020.recommendation: Use COPY when you only need to copy local files. Reserve ADD for archive extraction or remote URLs.
DL3020.impact: COPY provides more predictable behavior and reduces unintended side effects.

DL3021.title: COPY destination must end with slash
DL3021.recommendation: When copying multiple files, ensure the destination is a directory ending with '/'.
DL3021.impact: Prevents ambiguous copy behavior and build failures.

DL3022.title: COPY --from should reference an existing stage
DL3022.recommendation: Ensure COPY --from references a valid build stage or image.
DL3022.impact: Invalid stage references cause Docker build failures.

DL3023.title: COPY --from cannot reference itself
DL3023.recommendation: Do not copy files from the current build stage into itself.

DL3024.title: Stage aliases should be unique
DL3024.recommendation: Assign a unique name to every build stage.
DL3024.impact: Duplicate aliases make Dockerfiles confusing and error-prone.

DL3025.title: COPY --from should use a valid image or stage
DL3025.recommendation: Verify that COPY --from points to a valid image or previously defined stage.

DL3026.title: Use trusted base images
DL3026.recommendation: Build from trusted and verified container images whenever possible.

DL3027.title: Avoid repeated FROM aliases
DL3027.recommendation: Reuse existing stage aliases consistently and avoid duplicate definitions.
DL3027.impact: Improves readability and prevents build confusion.

DL3028.title: Use a valid image reference
DL3028.recommendation: Specify valid repository names and tags in FROM instructions.
DL3028.impact: Invalid image references cause build failures.

DL3029.title: Avoid platform-specific assumptions
DL3029.recommendation: Write Dockerfiles that are portable across supported platforms whenever possible.

DL3030.title: Use proper shell syntax
DL3030.recommendation: Follow recommended shell syntax and quoting practices in RUN instructions.
DL3030.impact: Reduces scripting errors and improves maintainability.

DL3031.title: Avoid unnecessary package installation
DL3031.recommendation: Install only the packages required for the application.
DL3031.impact: Reduces attack surface and image size.

DL3032.title: Minimize Docker image layers
DL3032.recommendation: Combine related RUN instructions where appropriate.
DL3032.impact: Produces smaller and more efficient container images.

DL3033.title: Avoid unnecessary files
DL3033.recommendation: Remove temporary files after installation steps.
DL3033.impact: Reduces image size and potential information exposure.

DL3034.title: Prefer deterministic builds
DL3034.recommendation: Pin versions and avoid downloading changing content during builds.

DL3035.title: Use secure download methods
DL3035.recommendation: Verify downloaded files using checksums or signatures.
DL3035.impact: Protects against tampered or malicious downloads.

DL3036.title: Avoid unnecessary root privileges
DL3036.recommendation: Drop privileges whenever possible by switching to a non-root user.
DL3036.impact: Limits the impact of a compromised container.

DL3037.title: Document exposed services
DL3037.recommendation: Clearly expose only the ports required by the application.

DL3038.title: Keep Dockerfiles maintainable
DL3038.recommendation: Group related instructions and use descriptive stage names.

DL3039.title: Follow Dockerfile best practices
DL3039.recommendation: Review Dockerfiles regularly against current Docker and Hadolint recommendations.
DL3039.impact: Helps maintain secure, efficient, and reliable container builds.

DL3040.title: Use WORKDIR instead of repeated cd commands
DL3040.recommendation: Set the working directory using the WORKDIR instruction rather than using 'cd' inside RUN commands.
DL3040.impact: Improves readability, portability, and Docker layer consistency.

DL3041.title: Avoid using latest package versions implicitly
DL3041.recommendation: Pin package versions whenever practical to ensure reproducible builds.
DL3041.impact: Reduces unexpected behavior caused by upstream package updates.

DL3042.title: Avoid unnecessary package recommendations
DL3042.recommendation: Install only required dependencies and disable optional recommended packages where appropriate.
DL3042.impact: Produces smaller images with a reduced attack surface.

DL3043.title: Avoid caching unnecessary package metadata
DL3043.recommendation: Clean package manager caches after installation if they are no longer required.

DL3044.title: Avoid duplicate package installation
DL3044.recommendation: Install each package only once within the build process.
DL3044.impact: Simplifies Dockerfiles and improves build efficiency.

DL3045.title: Use secure package repositories
DL3045.recommendation: Install packages only from trusted and verified repositories.

DL3046.title: Keep Docker images minimal
DL3046.recommendation: Remove unnecessary tools, packages, and temporary files from the final image.
DL3046.impact: Smaller images improve performance and reduce attack surface.

DL3047.title: Avoid unnecessary build dependencies
DL3047.recommendation: Use multi-stage builds to keep build tools out of production images.
DL3047.impact: Creates smaller, more secure runtime containers.

DL3048.title: Verify downloaded artifacts
DL3048.recommendation: Validate downloaded files using checksums or cryptographic signatures.
DL3048.impact: Protects against corrupted or malicious downloads.

DL3049.title: Use explicit package versions
DL3049.recommendation: Specify explicit package versions where reproducibility is important.

DL3050.title: Avoid unnecessary shell usage
DL3050.recommendation: Prefer exec-form instructions when shell processing is not required.
DL3050.impact: Improves signal handling and reduces shell-related issues.

DL3051.title: Document image purpose
DL3051.recommendation: Include labels that describe the image, maintainer, and version.

DL3052.title: Use OCI-compliant image labels
DL3052.recommendation: Follow the Open Container Initiative image label specification.

DL3053.title: Provide image source information
DL3053.recommendation: Include repository and source-code metadata using OCI labels.
DL3053.impact: Improves traceability and software supply-chain visibility.

DL3054.title: Provide image version label
DL3054.recommendation: Include an OCI version label that matches the application release.
DL3054.impact: Simplifies image identification and lifecycle management.

DL3055.title: Provide image license information
DL3055.recommendation: Include the appropriate OCI license label.

DL3056.title: Provide vendor information
DL3056.recommendation: Include the OCI vendor label identifying the software publisher.

DL3057.title: Provide image documentation URL
DL3057.recommendation: Include a documentation label pointing to user or developer documentation.
DL3057.impact: Makes operational documentation easier to locate.

DL3058.title: Provide revision information
DL3058.recommendation: Include the source-code revision or Git commit in image metadata.

DL3059.title: Provide image creation timestamp
DL3059.recommendation: Include a standardized image creation timestamp.

DL4000.title: Use MAINTAINER is deprecated
DL4000.recommendation: Replace the deprecated MAINTAINER instruction with the OCI LABEL instruction.
DL4000.impact: Ensures compatibility with modern Docker image standards.

DL4001.title: Use LABEL instead of MAINTAINER
DL4001.recommendation: Store maintainer information using OCI-compliant LABEL metadata.

DL4003.title: Multiple CMD instructions
DL4003.recommendation: Only one CMD instruction should exist in a Dockerfile. Remove redundant CMD statements.
DL4003.impact: Only the last CMD instruction is executed; earlier ones are ignored.

DL4004.title: Multiple ENTRYPOINT instructions
DL4004.recommendation: Use only one ENTRYPOINT instruction in the Dockerfile.
DL4004.impact: Only the final ENTRYPOINT takes effect, which may cause unexpected behavior.

DL4005.title: Multiple HEALTHCHECK instructions
DL4005.recommendation: Use a single HEALTHCHECK instruction for the container.
DL4005.impact: Docker ignores all HEALTHCHECK instructions except the last one.

DL4006.title: Set a default shell explicitly
DL4006.recommendation: Use the SHELL instruction when a non-default shell is required.
DL4006.impact: Improves portability and avoids shell-specific behavior differences.
